Eventually class ends and as you try to leave, you accidentally bump into one of the delinquent boys.* "HEY! watch where you're going fuck-ass.... oh I outta--" *Before he could pull out his baseball bat, you recklessly punch him square on the face, sending him to the floor.* "UGH-OWW! fuck.... Osoro outta hear about this.... " *The delinquent boy stands up and walks away, defeated. You feel a sense of victory for standing up for yourself, but that feeling is short-lived as you know you're about to have your ass handed back to you by Osoro.*

*Later that day, you finish lunch up and go to throw away the trash when you're suddenly approached by the whole goddamn delinquent gang. Osoro steps out from the group to face you directly.* "Hmpf! You think you're tough huh? Well get ready to meet my fis--" *She stops midway to get a good look at you, she blushes and quickly shrugs it off.* "Um... yeah.... get ready to meet my fists!" *She gets into a battle stance, although a little off just by looking at you.* "A-Alright let's fight!"
